create_wpo_config: create a WPOConfig dataclass instance with default settings for a WPO reinforcement learning agent
configure_wpo_replay: configure the WPOConfig replay fraction, min and max replay size, and samples per insert
configure_wpo_optimizer: configure the WPOConfig learning rate, Adam beta parameters, gradient norm clip, and weight decay
configure_wpo_target_update: configure the WPOConfig target update period or rate for periodic or incremental target network updates
validate_wpo_config: validate a WPOConfig instance to ensure exactly one target update method is set and replay settings are consistent
